Generate the Standalone Base-R Cluster Worker Script

Source: R/sbatch.R
render_worker_script.Rd

Emits a self-contained R script (worker.R) that executes one SLURM array chunk on a compute node with zero dependency on slurmpilot itself. The worker loads payload.rds and chunks.rds, validates checkpoint SHA-256 integrity before skipping completed chunks, initializes independent L'Ecuyer-CMRG per-chunk / per-task parallel RNG streams via base parallel::nextRNGStream() and parallel::nextRNGSubStream(), writes atomic .rds result checkpoints with .sha256 sidecar digests and .json status telemetry, and propagates non-zero exit codes on task failure.

Usage

render_worker_script(output_path = NULL)

Arguments

output_path

Optional file path to write worker.R.

Value

Character vector of script lines (invisibly if output_path is provided, otherwise visibly).

See also

render_sbatch_script(), verify_checkpoint()

Examples

script_lines <- render_worker_script()
head(script_lines, 10)
#>  [1] "#!/usr/bin/env Rscript"                                                                                  
#>  [2] "# Auto-generated by slurmpilot: standalone zero-dependency array chunk worker"                           
#>  [3] "# Features: atomic checkpoints, SHA-256 sidecars, L'Ecuyer-CMRG parallel RNG streams"                    
#>  [4] ""                                                                                                        
#>  [5] "parse_cli_args <- function(args) {"                                                                      
#>  [6] "  out <- list("                                                                                          
#>  [7] "    work_dir = Sys.getenv('SLURMPILOT_WORK_DIR', unset = getwd()),"                                      
#>  [8] "    chunk_id = Sys.getenv('SLURMPILOT_CHUNK_ID', unset = Sys.getenv('SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID', unset = '')),"
#>  [9] "    attempt = Sys.getenv('SLURMPILOT_ATTEMPT', unset = '1'),"                                            
#> [10] "    force = FALSE"
